groups.name: Base VRChat SDK types
groups.revision: Avatar SDK3 type inventory in AVATAR_CONVERSION_SCOPE.md, 2026-10-24
groups.boundary: 28 explicitly inventoried SDK component/behavior/asset types from scope sections 1-2. This denominator is not every SDK utility type, Unity component, controller feature or built-in signal. General Unity animation/geometry/rendering coverage is a separate dependency, not credited here.

groups.name: Modular Avatar components
groups.boundary: 40 concrete Runtime authored types: 38 nonabstract tag-derived components plus MAMoveIndependently and the MMD state behavior. ShapeChanger Set/Delete are one component. Abstract bases and editor infrastructure are not components; excluded concrete types remain counted.

entries.name: MAMoveIndependently
entries.reason: Authoring relative-placement helper; preserve authored transforms, not editor live-lock machinery.

entries.name: ModularAvatarBlendshapeSync

entries.name: ModularAvatarBoneProxy

entries.name: ModularAvatarConvertConstraints

entries.name: ModularAvatarFloorAdjuster

entries.name: ModularAvatarGlobalCollider

entries.name: ModularAvatarMaterialSetter

entries.name: ModularAvatarMaterialSwap

entries.name: ModularAvatarMenuInstallTarget

entries.name: ModularAvatarMergeAnimator

entries.name: ModularAvatarMergeBlendTree

entries.name: ModularAvatarMeshSettings

entries.name: ModularAvatarMMDLayerControl

entries.name: ModularAvatarMoveTo

entries.name: ModularAvatarOutfitRoot

entries.name: ModularAvatarParameters

entries.name: ModularAvatarPBBlocker

entries.name: ModularAvatarPlatformFilter

groups.name: VRCFury action models

groups.name: VRCFury wrapper components
groups.boundary: 12 concrete VRCFury-prefixed Runtime MonoBehaviour wrappers from Component/ and Model/: nine Component/ wrappers plus container/debug/test types. The two abstract lifecycle bases are excluded as schemas. Debug/editor concrete types stay in the denominator with explicit exclusion status. Container recognition is indexed-only to avoid duplicate support credit.
